constraints.copy: All page copy is the clone's original placeholder text; rig.ai's own wording must never be reproduced (rule ORIGINAL_COPY_FINGERPRINT).
constraints.realCompanyContent: rig.ai is a live company: its name/wordmark/logo marks must not be reproduced in generated output; Chalet is commercially licensed. See assets/asset-roles.json realCompanyPolicy + fontPolicy.
constraints.noBackend: Forms are front-end only (submission.mode local-only, localStorage dashboard). Generated pages must not wire real submission endpoints without human review (rule NO_BACKEND_ENDPOINTS).
constraints.externalLinks: Link targets are closed kinds: route | fragment | placeholder | share-intent | email-placeholder (rule NO_EXTERNAL_TARGETS).
